I was initially seen by an out-of-hours doctor who was thorough and professional. She advised that I would need a further ultrasound and an in-person examination, and she arranged blood tests for me to collect from the surgery.
The following morning, I called early and was able to secure an appointment for 11:30am. While the initial process was efficient and well organised, my experience with the doctor I saw at the surgery was disappointing.

My appointment was at 11.30am but I waited for an hour and was not called in until 12:30pm.

Although the doctor apologised for the lateness, the first thing she said upon sitting down was that we “only had 15 minutes,” and she immediately set a timer on her clock
This made me feel rushed and anxious, particularly as I have been dealing with ongoing symptoms that have not yet been properly addressed.

During the appointment, I required an internal examination and swabs, and I was repeatedly reminded that we did not have much time before and after the assessment. She said this 3 times within a matter of 5 minutes.
During the time I was waiting and even after I was seen, the surgery was empty and I appeared to be the only patient remaining, so it was difficult to understand the need to rush the consultation so significantly.
I explained that I strongly suspect endometriosis, as my symptoms align closely, and I requested a referral to a specialist and a further scan, particularly as I had an ultrasound in May. I was surprised when the doctor asked whether I had private medical insurance. I am unsure why this was relevant, as NHS patients are entitled to investigations for long-standing and unresolved symptoms.
The doctor appeared unfamiliar with my medical history and was unable to see or reference the blood tests already arranged by the out-of-hours doctor. That was dismissed and she said she would do her own but this did not include the previous bloods that they had requested When I asked what was recorded in my notes, my symptoms were reduced to “bloating,” despite having discussed much more detailed concerns of pain earlier that morning and night before.
She advised she would arrange her own blood tests but stated that hormone testing and a further ultrasound were not necessary, which directly contradicted the advice I had already been given.
I attempted to show her the visible abdominal bloating I am experiencing, but she did not turn to look and remained focused on her screen.
I was trying to tell her about the bloods that the lady had requested the night before but she said to not talk as she had to concentrate on the bloods requested.
A urine test was carried out and came back normal, as previous tests have also been normal and do not explain the persistent heavy, dull abdominal pain I am experiencing. As well as the
Ongoing Need to urgently wee.

I have had excellent care from other doctors at this surgery in the past, which made this experience very disappointing. I left the appointment feeling unheard, rushed, and no closer to getting answers for symptoms that have been ongoing for a long time.
I really need an MRI on my lower abdomen to detect endometriosis. The blood tests are not going to detect the sharp pains I am getting
Internally.",null,[0,239]]]],[null,1772616789000000,1772616789000000,"2 weeks ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/8199727516797261615/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXZW1OSFpHWlVSVGx5WkVobk5XVnJTbmhpUlVwbVkyMHhSRTlGUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/8199727516797261615/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXZW1OSFpHWlVSVGx5WkVobk5XVnJTbmhpUlVwbVkyMHhSRTlGUlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/8199727516797261615/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXZW1OSFpHWlVSVGx5WkVobk5XVnJTbmhpUlVwbVkyMHhSRTlGUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/8199727516797261615/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXZW1OSFpHWlVSVGx5WkVobk5XVnJTbmhpUlVwbVkyMHhSRTlGUlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/8199727516797261615/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXZW1OSFpHWlVSVGx5WkVobk5XVnJTbmhpUlVwbVkyMHhSRTlGUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/8199727516797261615/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXZW1OSFpHWlVSVGx5WkVobk5XVnJTbmhpUlVwbVkyMHhSRTlGUlJBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["We are sorry to hear about your experience with the practice, I hope that the issues are now resolved since following this up with you.
